title: Find The Maximum Length Of Valid Subsequence I
statement:
A subsequence is valid when the parity of the sum of every adjacent pair is the same. Return the maximum length of a valid subsequence of `nums`.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 3, 4]
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2]
Output: 6
```

```text
Input: nums = [1, 3]
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `2 <= nums.length <= 2 * 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^7`
